sects.name: Heavenly Sword
sects.philosophy: The blade is the only honest truth.
sects.territory: Cliff spires above the eastern pass
sects.fault_line: Reformers want outside disciples; hardliners call it dilution.

method.name: Sword Heart Method
method.path: Sword intent grows only in real combat; sitting feeds it almost nothing.

technique.name: Heaven Splitting Slash
technique.path: One committed cut that opens a line of foes.

sects.name: Azure Cloud
sects.philosophy: Harmony through the balance of elements.

method.name: Five Elements Cycle
method.path: Each element feeds the next; a closed cycle turns patience into power.

technique.name: Azure Cloud Palm
technique.path: A palm of gathered cloud that chills what it passes through.

sects.name: Crimson Lotus
sects.philosophy: Beauty, poison and desire are one art.
sects.economy: Pleasure houses and the poison trade

method.name: Lotus Ecstasy Art
method.path: Feeling is fuel; the art blooms brightest when the heart is unguarded.

technique.name: Thousand Petal Illusion
technique.path: A drift of petals that cuts only after the eye believes it is perfume.

sects.name: Thousand Beast
sects.philosophy: Beasts are people with clearer instincts.
sects.fault_line: The slave-beast faction against the communion faction.

method.name: Beast Soul Communion
method.path: A borrowed heartbeat lends strength; the beast remembers every debt.

technique.name: Nine Beast Stampede
technique.path: Nine spirits answer the call and trample a path through the fight.

sects.name: Celestial Formation
sects.philosophy: Reality is a diagram waiting to be drawn.
sects.fault_line: The grand array is failing, and they are hiding it.

method.name: Array Heart Sutra
method.path: The body is a formation; each breath closes another circuit.

technique.name: Ninefold Sealing Array
technique.path: A ring of seals closes and locks everything inside it in place.

sects.name: Blood Moon Palace
sects.fault_line: Succession by murder is doctrine, and it just happened.

method.name: Blood Sea Scripture
method.path: Absorb compatible blood essence; speed is bought with corruption.

technique.name: Crimson Moon Devour
technique.path: A draining arc that drinks what it wounds.

sects.name: Eternal Medicine Valley
sects.fault_line: A cure for a plague they themselves spread.

method.name: Longevity Wood Canon
method.path: Growth is cultivated like a garden: slow, tended, impossible to hurry.

technique.name: Nine Reversal Needles
technique.path: Nine needles fly to the body's own meridians, mending or severing.

sects.name: Shadow Veil
sects.philosophy: Information is the only real currency.
sects.fault_line: Someone is selling secrets to all twelve.

method.name: Phantom Trace Method
method.path: Every secret learned is a step; the path is walked where no one looks.

technique.name: Veil of Ten Thousand Faces
technique.path: For a breath the body is nobody, and every blow seeks the wrong person.

sects.name: Thunder Sovereign
sects.territory: Storm peaks above the cloud line
sects.economy: Tribulation guiding, rented by the hour
sects.fault_line: They can induce tribulations, and they rent that power.

method.name: Nine Heavens Thunder Law
method.path: Lightning is courted, not commanded; the law answers only the bold.

technique.name: Sovereign Thunderfall
technique.path: A verdict called down from the sky, with the caster standing in it.

sects.name: Frozen Heaven
sects.fault_line: An elder is thawing, and remembers love.

method.name: Absolute Yin Scripture
method.path: Stillness is the method; feeling is the impurity that slows the freeze.

technique.name: Frost Soul Requiem
technique.path: A hymn that freezes the will before the body has time to shiver.

sects.name: Golden Cauldron
sects.territory: Furnace city at the river's mouth
sects.fault_line: A commission for a weapon that can kill gods.

method.name: Cauldron Fire Canon
method.path: The self is refined like metal: heat, hammer, fold, repeat.

technique.name: Ten Thousand Refinements
technique.path: Every strike tempers the body that delivers it.

sects.name: Void Scripture Pavilion
sects.philosophy: Knowledge must be catalogued, not owned.
sects.territory: A library that drifts between the peaks
sects.fault_line: The archive holds a book that rewrites its readers.

method.name: Void Archive Method
method.path: Understanding is stored, not spent; the page remembers what the mind forgets.

technique.name: Page of Unmaking
technique.path: A sentence read aloud that edits the target out of the scene.
